newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hongkong Bank to open new branch in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Hongkong Bank to open new branch in Shanghai.

text.p: Hongkong & Shanghai Banking Corp said on Monday it has received approval from the People's Bank of China to open a new branch in the Pudong district of Shanghai.
The new branch will serve as the bank's main branch in the Chinese city, it said in a statement.
The approval coincided with the central bank's naming of Hongkong Bank, the banking unit of HSBC Holdings Plc, to conduct Chinese currency business in Shanghai.
Three other banks -- Citibank, Tokyo-Mitsubishi Bank and the Industrial Bank of Japan -- also received approval to conduct renminbi business.
Only banks with branches in Pudong are allowed to apply to do local currency business.
